fields.name: compare_at_price
fields.description: Original price for showing discount (optional, 0 if none)

fields.name: stock_quantity
fields.description: Units in stock (for in_stock items) or units available to pre-order

fields.name: product_type
fields.description: Whether item ships now or is a pre-order

fields.name: release_date
fields.description: Expected release/ship date for pre-order items

fields.name: deposit_percent
fields.description: Percent of price required as deposit for pre-order (0-100), 0 = full payment

fields.name: items
fields.description: JSON string of ordered line items (id, name, price, qty, type, image, variation)

fields.name: total
fields.description: Order total amount due now (deposit or full)

fields.name: order_type
fields.description: Whether order contains in-stock, pre-order, or mixed items

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Internal admin notes (coupon code/discount applied is recorded here as text)

fields.name: paystack_reference
fields.description: Paystack transaction reference, for card/bank_transfer/opay payments verified via Paystack

fields.name: offline_receipt_url
fields.description: Compressed data-URL image of the payment receipt the customer uploaded for offline/manual bank transfer payments

fields.name: admin_password
fields.description: Admin dashboard password (demo only, not secure)

fields.name: paystack_public_key
fields.description: Paystack public key (pk_...), used client-side to initialize Paystack Inline payments

fields.name: paystack_secret_key
fields.description: Paystack secret key (sk_...). NOTE: stored in plain text in table data on this static site; do not treat as secure — used only for admin reference, never sent from the browser at checkout

fields.name: paystack_enabled
fields.description: Whether Paystack-powered payment methods (Card, Bank Transfer, Opay) are offered at checkout

fields.name: paystack_currency
fields.description: 3-letter currency code Paystack should charge in (must match your Paystack account's supported currency), e.g. NGN, GHS, ZAR, USD

fields.name: offline_payment_enabled
fields.description: Whether the manual/offline bank transfer payment method is offered at checkout

fields.name: offline_bank_name
fields.description: Bank name shown to customers for manual/offline bank transfer

fields.name: offline_account_name
fields.description: Account holder name shown to customers for manual/offline bank transfer

fields.name: offline_account_number
fields.description: Account number shown to customers for manual/offline bank transfer

fields.name: offline_instructions
fields.description: Extra instructions shown to customers for manual/offline bank transfer (e.g. reference format)

fields.name: name
fields.description: Category display name (must match products.category to link products)

fields.name: icon
fields.description: Font Awesome icon class, e.g. fa-shirt

fields.name: code
fields.description: Coupon code customers enter at checkout (case-insensitive)

fields.name: discount_value
fields.description: Discount amount: percent (0-100) or fixed currency amount

fields.name: min_order
fields.description: Minimum order subtotal required to use this coupon (0 = no minimum)

fields.name: max_uses
fields.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be used (0 = unlimited)

fields.name: used_count
fields.description: How many times this coupon has been used so far

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether the coupon can currently be used

fields.name: primary_color
fields.description: Main brand color (hex), used for buttons/links/logo

fields.name: accent_color
fields.description: Accent color (hex), used for pre-order badges/highlights

fields.name: dark_color
fields.description: Dark color (hex), used for header/footer/sidebar background

fields.name: success_color
fields.description: Success color (hex), used for in-stock/positive states

fields.name: danger_color
fields.description: Danger color (hex), used for sale/out-of-stock states

fields.name: announcement_text
fields.description: Top announcement bar text shown on every storefront page

fields.name: hero_badge_text
fields.description: Small badge text above the homepage hero heading

fields.name: trust_badge_1_icon
fields.description: Font Awesome icon class for trust badge 1

fields.name: trust_badge_2_icon
fields.description: Font Awesome icon class for trust badge 2

fields.name: trust_badge_3_icon
fields.description: Font Awesome icon class for trust badge 3

fields.name: footer_about_text
fields.description: Short about text shown in the footer

fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.description: WhatsApp number (digits only, with country code) for the floating chat button

fields.name: free_shipping_threshold
fields.description: Order subtotal above which shipping is free (0 = disabled)

fields.name: url
fields.description: Media URL: hosted link, a compressed data URL for uploaded images, or empty when the video is stored chunked (see is_chunked)

fields.name: is_chunked
fields.description: True if this video's data is split across media_chunks rows (large uploaded videos) rather than stored in url

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Display order within the product gallery (lower = first)

fields.name: group_name
fields.description: Variation group name, e.g. Color or Size

fields.name: group_values
fields.description: List of option values for this group, e.g. ['Red','Blue','Green']

fields.name: sort_order
fields.description: Display order of this group on the product page

fields.name: message
fields.description: Customer-visible tracking update message shown on the Track Order page

fields.name: media_id
fields.description: The product_media row this chunk belongs to

fields.name: chunk_index
fields.description: Order of this chunk (0-based) — chunks are joined in this order to reconstruct the full video data URL

fields.name: chunk_data
fields.description: A slice of the base64 video data URL (kept under the per-field size cap)
